content: Correct the repository toolchain boundary: Nix pins and exposes tool versions only; independent project tooling owns configure, build, test, packaging, evidence, source-state, and cleanup semantics; milestone M0100 remains a task and acceptance definition rather than the canonical toolchain policy.

D0022 supersedes D0021: toolchains/README.md owns portable tool identity; Nix only materializes and exposes fixed tools, while Git, CMake/Ninja, CTest/tests, packaging, sessions, and the host retain their existing responsibilities. Updated agent/memory/constraints.md, agent/memory/decisions-index.md, agent/plan/M0100-core-foundation/plan.md, and agent/plan/M0100-core-foundation/work/W0101-build-toolchain.md.

Session cleanup removed 5.7 GiB of Git-ignored project build trees under build/ after confirming no CMake, Ninja, or CTest process was active. CMake preset outputs now use the repository-external .metaflux-build/MetaFlux-Core hierarchy so future sessions can clean exact owned work directories without involving Nix or Git source state.

Added and officially validated the manage-toolchain skill, then independently forward-tested a mixed request: the skill kept llvm-cov provisioning in Nix while routing CTest and package construction back to their owning tools. Rewrote record-session and its template/scaffolder/validator contract so sessions curate durable outcomes and clean session-owned failed-route artifacts rather than snapshotting source or builds.

The corrected flake exposes only tool packages, four development shells, and a formatter. Version probes reported Clang/LLVM 22.1.8, CMake 4.1.6, and Ninja 1.13.2. After removing a duplicate Clang wrapper and suppressing the mkShell self-RPATH, the repository-external dev preset configured, built, and passed all 58 CTest cases; two runner suites passed 12/12 each and the Agent validator self-test passed 54/54.

Explicit host cleanup revalidated and deleted exactly 164 Nix-dead /nix/store/*-source paths that contained MetaFlux flake identity, an embedded build directory, and at least 1 GiB each. Nix reported 564.1 GiB freed; matching large dead MetaFlux source paths fell to zero, /nix/store measured 38 GiB, and root filesystem use fell from 100% to 40%. No broad GC or toolchain closure deletion was run.

Content revision 7b86b35552c0a52661071cf6a74b76aef1faf289 records the current M0100 foundation and corrected tool/session boundary. After verification, cleanup removed the exact 568 MiB repository-external .metaflux-build/MetaFlux-Core/dev tree created by this session. Session and checkpoint records are committed separately.
